Jules Park: Heads-up 1: Final on-site/hybrid loop for candidate Marco Reyes is currently set for Tue 8am PT (which is 11pm PHT). He asked if we can offer an APAC-friendly slot or a hybrid option.
Samir Gupta: Good catch. We should push later in the day so it's not overnight for him. I'm available at 1pm PT (1am PHT) and 4pm PT (5am PHT) 5 not ideal. Maybe 6pm PT? That's 9am PHT.
Priya Menon: 6pm PT / 9am PHT works for the interviewers on my side. Can Marco do an in-person at our Manila partner office or does he need remote only?
Jules Park: He indicated he'd prefer in-person if we can cover transit. He also needs a letter for his employer to approve time off (not a visa).
Oliver Ng: We have a small partner room in Makati we can book. If we reimburse transit, what expense code do we use? Also Marco mentioned he prefers macOS for the coding task. Do we have a Mac loaner available?
Priya Menon: Expense code: TRVL-LOCAL. For loaners, we have two MacBook Airs at the Manila hub (asset IDs A-234, A-238). Oliver, can you check availability and whether they're imaged with our test environment?
Oliver Ng: Checking now. A-234 is free but needs the dev toolchain. Imaging will take ~3 hours. If we book the room and schedule shipping of the other device from HQ, shipping ETA is 48 hours.
Samir Gupta: If imaging takes 3 hours we can arrange imaging today and pick up tomorrow. Jules, does Marco need any accessibility support (live captions, extra time) or dietary restrictions if we order lunch?
Jules Park: He asked for live captions and a quiet room due to chronic tinnitus. No dietary restrictions, but prefer halal options. Can we add those notes to the invite?
TalentOps-Bot: Reminder: Book partner room 'Makati-Room-B' and set Zoom fallback. Add captioning enabled. Use shipping code HIRE-LOGISTICS if shipping device.
Priya Menon: I'll book the room and add Zoom link + captions. Jules, please add "employer leave letter" request details (full legal name + employer contact) via DM so we don't post PII here.
Jules Park: DM sent to Priya with Marco's legal name and employer contact. Also marked candidate in Greenhouse: "needs-loaner, local-reimbursement".
Oliver Ng: Imaging scheduled tonight for A-234. I'll confirm pickup window and badge access for Marco. If he prefers device shipped, I'll initiate HIRE-LOGISTICS.
Samir Gupta: Thanks all. Final interview slot updated to Tue 6pm PT / Wed 9am PHT in the calendar. Invite includes room address, Zoom fallback, captions, and reimbursement note (TRVL-LOCAL).
Jules Park: Appreciate the quick turn. Will follow up with Marco to confirm transit pickup vs shipped device. :thumbsup:
